definitions.explanation: The transmission of digital data, especially mobile internet data on smartphones and other devices. Commonly encountered when discussing phone plans and data usage.

examples.japanese: データ{通信|つうしん}の{量|りょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the amount of data usage.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}のデータ{通信量|つうしんりょう}がもう{上限|じょうげん}に{近|ちか}い。
examples.english: This month's data usage is already close to the limit.

examples.japanese: Wi-Fiに{接続|せつぞく}すれば、データ{通信量|つうしんりょう}を{節約|せつやく}できる。
examples.english: You can save on data usage by connecting to Wi-Fi.

notes:
USAGE:
A very practical term in modern Japan. Phone carriers advertise plans with specific データ{通信量|つうしんりょう} (data allowance), and exceeding the limit results in {速度制限|そくどせいげん} (speed throttling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{通信量|つうしんりょう}: data usage amount
- データ{通信|つうしん}{速度|そくど}: data transmission speed
- データ{通信|つうしん}{制限|せいげん}: data throttling/restriction
- データ{通信|つうしん}{専用|せんよう}: data-only (plan/SIM)
